{{Quote|<nowiki />''Shawda Clubb sandwich''<br />This popular sandwich boasts sliced Manpha-fowl, nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato.|Dexter Jettster, menu for Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Manpha''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]]. A [[Water/Legends|humid]] world with marshlands and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] on its single continent, it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Shawda Ubb primarily lived in many small communities scattered across Manpha's swamplands and harvested [[petroleum]] bubbling up out of the swamps. The substance was shipped to [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in Manpha's sole [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] community, the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Shanpan]], where it was processed into [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] for export offworld.

Atypically for a Shawda Ubb, the Manpha native [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]] desired to travel beyond Manpha. In order to earn [[Currency/Legends|money]] to fulfill that goal, Tivtotolon [[Musician/Legends|played]] [[Music/Legends|music]] and carried news to isolated communities across Manpha's continent. Eventually, the Shawda Ubb traveled to Shanpan, where he adopted the stage name "Rappertunie," and when the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] visited Manpha at some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Rappertunie joined the [[Band/Legends|band]] and accompanied Jabba and the musicians off Manpha.

==Description==
Manpha was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SE" /> located in the [[Manpha system/Legends|Manpha system]], a part of the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Sil'Lume system/Legends|Sil'Lume system]] as well as the [[Terminus system/Legends|Terminus system]] of the [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]].<ref name="OuterRim" />

A small world, Manpha had a single continent that featured marshlands and [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. It constantly [[Water/Legends|rained]] on the planet,<ref name="AE" /> and rich [[petroleum]] bubbled up out of its swamps.<ref name="SE" /> Manpha's marshes featured swamp [[Grass/Legends|grasses]] and [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="AE" /> The planet also shared its name with the creature known as [[Manpha-fowl]].<ref name="Dex" />

==History==
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Manpha was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[3000 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was situated outside of the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> although during the first campaigns of that conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the Republic's [[Nineteenth Army|Nineteenth Sector Army]] was nevertheless tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Manpha's vicinity. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Manpha was not a part of the territory controlled by the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|successor]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data from [[Manpha system/Legends|Manpha system]]</ref>

[[File:RappertunieCrop-DK.png|thumb|left|300px|The musician Rappertunie was native to Manpha.]]
From the [[Local day/Legends|day]] he [[Reproduction/Legends|hatched]]<ref name="SE" /> from his [[Egg/Legends|egg]],<ref name="AE" /> the Manpha native [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rapotwanalantonee Tivtotolon]]<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref> had an obssessive urge&mdash;in contrast to the rest of the planet's [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;to travel<ref name="FF75">{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}}</ref> and explore the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], one planet at a time.<ref name="Insider67" /> After Tivtotolon learned about<ref name="FF75" /> the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Shanpan]], Manpha's sole [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] community,<ref name="SE" /> the young Shawda Ubb devoted his every [[Sleep/Legends|waking]] [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] to earning enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to travel there.<ref name="FF75" /> He traveled extensively through the marsh communities of Manpha's continent, getting [[Currency/Legends|paid]] for [[Musician/Legends|playing]] [[Music/Legends|music]] and carrying news to isolated villages.<ref name="SE" />

By early adulthood, Tivtotolon had saved enough money<ref name="FF75" /> to use a planetary [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to travel to Shanpan.<ref name="SE" /> There, the Shawda Ubb musician played in many [[Band/Legends|bands]],<ref name="FF75" /> taking the more [[Alien/Legends|alien]]-friendly stage name "Rappertunie." In Shanpan's [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], Rappertunie conversed with visiting alien&mdash;predominantly [[Human/Legends|Human]]&mdash;[[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], and for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he sought a way to travel off Manpha.<ref name="SE" /> At some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="4 ABY">{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}} establishes that [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rappertunie]] left Manpha after [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates Jabba's [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="SE" /> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], which formed a part of Jabba's entourage, visited Manpha.<ref name="FF75" /> Rappertunie infiltrated the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] suite the Max Rebo Band was staying at and displayed his musical talents,<ref name="Insider67" /> which impressed the band's nominal leader, [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]], and ultimately gave the Shawda Ubb the opportunity to accompany the musicians and Jabba offworld.<ref name="SE" /> At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], Manpha was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Shawda Ubb/Legends}}
[[File:ShawdaUbb-AlienEncounters.png|thumb|right|295px|Manpha was the homeworld of the Shawda Ubb species.]]
Manpha was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Shawda Ubb, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] species<ref name="AE" /> originally descended from [[Bird/Legends|avians]]. The Shawda Ubb were well-adapted for their planet's humid conditions,<ref name="FF75" /> having evolved ridges on their foreheads that kept out rainwater out of their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="AE" /> The population of the Manpha [[Star system/Legends|system]] around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" /> The Shawda Ubb inhabited hundreds of thousands of small towns and villages scattered across the marshes and swamps of Manpha's continent. Those communities utilized a relatively low [[Technology level|level]] of technology.<ref name="AE" /> The [[Growdi Harmonique/Legends|Growdi Harmonique]] was a musical instrument originating on Manpha.<ref name="SE" />

Many of the Shawda Ubb communities practiced [[Oil/Legends|oil]]-refining, pumping into barrels the petroleum bubbling up out of the planet's swamps. The substance was sold to national oil companies based in Manpha's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, Shanpan, where [[Factory/Legends|factories]] processed the oil into high-grade [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] that were subsequently exported offworld. Shanpan was the only spaceport community on Manpha, and a large network of [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and shuttles serviced the Shawda Ubb oil companies. A significant industry was also in place for transporting Shawda Ubb [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] across the planet.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Manpha was introduced in the [[1997]] ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SE" /> The planet was given its first visual depiction in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]] and illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] and [[William O'Connor]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Manpha system, and therefore the planet, in grid square K-20.<ref name="TEA" />
